name: visitor

notes.what: The page is plain, unstyled text with no header, no link back to the site and no footer. Nothing on it can be pressed, so a visitor has to use the browser Back button. The lines are also very long on a desktop screen.
The switch is checked ("on") and its knob is at the end (left), but the track is grey, not blue. It looks half-off, so a person can't tell whether simple display is on.

The tab says "לא עלו דגלים אדומים בנתונים" (no red flags) with no price entered and no value estimate. It reads as a reassurance about the car, though the check covers only four registry items and the app says it can't see accidents or liens.
